title: Validate component ablation winner with multi-seed root optimizer
description: Follow up on the 2026-05-29 AnchorMuon component ablation. The single-seed worker run found -PMuonEq and -NorMuon slightly ahead of the full worker recipe at 50 epochs, while no-SODA fell behind after looking strong at 12 epochs. Re-run full vs -PMuonEq vs -NorMuon over multiple seeds, then validate the winner through root optimizer.py before changing the shippable default.
notes: Completed the multi-seed worker replay: full AnchorMuon vs -PMuonEq vs -NorMuon, 50 epochs, seeds 123/456/789. Full had best mean test acc (84.94 +/- 0.10) but only +0.11 pp over -PMuonEq; -PMuonEq was about 11% faster. NorMuon removal was worse on mean. Remaining work in this issue is direct root optimizer.py validation before changing defaults.
